adjudications.evidence: SI Figure5; SI Table1 footnote d; article Methods/S8 and S11.
adjudications.decision: Four complete tagged strings are directly printed; eight are explicitly derived. Preserve five surface changes relative to earlier RA95.0, S53T versus source E53T wording and S43R reversion. 1LBL plus11 design/5 surface substitutions is source-reported origin only; exact ancestor sequence is unacquired.

adjudications.objection: Unmarked Table2 rows could inherit fluorescence method, conditions or SD semantics.
adjudications.evidence: SI Table2 page3 first3 RA95.0 rows lack a markers; later8 rows are marked. SI Figure1 separately confirms main-lineage UV-vis.
adjudications.decision: Unmarked rows have a distinct unresolved assay binding, null condition/technique assignment and literal plus-minus magnitude without an asserted SD type. Marked fluorescence and main UV-vis remain separate; no parent values are exchanged.

adjudications.objection: Source unit and arithmetic inconsistencies could be silently normalized.
adjudications.evidence: Visual SI Table2 KM header M; efficiency arithmetic differs by approximately10^6. Excluded SI Table1 E53A/RA95.5 S/selectivity inconsistencies.
adjudications.decision: Retain literal KM numbers/M unit with normalized value/unit null. Preserve reported efficiency column and same-column ratios without repairing the source. Excluded inconsistent rows support no extra claims.

adjudications.objection: Fluorescence kinetic parameters could acquire an explicit fitting-model claim absent from the source.
adjudications.evidence: SI Table2 and main fluorescence Methods/S15; explicit Michaelis-Menten equation only in UV-vis Methods/S16.
adjudications.decision: Use source-reported kinetic parameter wording for fluorescence; no raw trace refit or asserted fluorescence equation. UV-vis retains its explicit model.

adjudications.objection: An engineered double-substitution derivative could be presented as an evolved clone; positive or nd data could receive generic functional labels.
adjudications.decision: Distinguish engineered K83M/K210M derivatives of evolved backgrounds. Retain small positive parameter values; RA95.0-K210M nd is null with no numeric detection limit. Neither implies a generic activity status or a third catalytic residue.

adjudications.objection: Site perturbation could isolate chemical participation or propagate through every displayed lineage member.
adjudications.evidence: The packet has K83/K210 perturbations through RA95.5-5, but only sequence/kinetic context for RA95.5-8. Parent structures are inhibitor-adduct models.
adjudications.decision: Record background/parameter-specific substitution sensitivity. Leave RA95.5-8 site assignment unresolved. No mutant fold-control/structure or elementary-step evidence is retained to isolate chemical participation from structural effects; no coordinate files are acquired or mapped.

adjudications.objection: Integration might only republish a known result or imply an unbiased design-success cohort.
adjudications.evidence: Study already reports active-site remodeling; retained rows are selected lineage and mechanistic perturbations.
adjudications.decision: Value is reusable eligibility for exact sequence joins and background/parameter-bound labels. No novelty, measured speedup, comparative accuracy or design-success denominator is asserted; no unreported screen clone is classified as a failure.
